items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: No, not Ollie Mitchell, (Wilson) it's a different guy's name.

ctx.x: Yeah, we had Earl Swope in that, and a guy I just saw for the first time in years recently, Ollie--

Ollie Mitchell. No, not Ollie Mitchell, (Wilson) it's a different guy's name. Ollie -- and he was from Washington, D.C. When we needed replacements or were looking for people, we got a lot of guys from Washington.
